findings.issue: הָרִבְלָה is article plus proper noun, with no preposition and no directional suffix. Unmarked “a” adds a destination the token does not mark.
The definite article is left as Hebrew ha- instead of a Spanish article.
Lemma 4229 b, qal sequential perfect 3ms, licenses strike or reach, not give.

notes: Repeated descenderá el límite, desde Shefam, desde oriente a Ayin, sobre hombro de mar de Kinéret, and hacia oriente match their tokens.
